name: Motu Patlu
description: Inspired by the characters of Lot Pot Comics, Motu Patlu is a lively comic caper for the kids as well as the entire family. Set in the beautiful city of Furfuri Nagariya, the story is about Motu and Patlu, who are as similar as chalk and cheese. The Awesome Twosome are always on an adventurous expedition and have an uncanny ability to get into tricky situations every single day! It was premiered on 16 October 2012, beginning with the episode "John Banega Don". It focuses on two friends, Motu and Patlu, living in the fictional city Furfuri Nagar.

credits_cast.character: Motu / Patlu / Dr. Jhatka / Ghasita Ram / Chingam / John / Boxer (voice)
credits_cast.name: Saurav Chakraborty

videos.title: Motu Patlu in Wonderland!
videos.overview: Motu dreams of interdicting a criminal assault on a samosa vault on a high tower skyscraper in Dubai. He promptly starts eating them, and half-awake, beats Patlu unconsciously. When he awakens, he decides to go for samosas to the local tea shop. However, as Patlu reminds him that they have to pay him money for all samosas they have eaten for free, their attention is diverted by Chhotu, Motu's nephew and son of his sister Munni. Motu also apprehends John the Don and is goons fleeing Inspector Chingum. When the tea-seller denies Motu access to samosas, a crestfallen Chhotu requests him to give him some. He tries to please the enraged Motu; unable to control his greed, he eats the samosas. Bounded by autos in a circular motion, the title song, depicting their friendship, plays out with Ghasita Ram, Dr. Jhatka, Chhotu, Chaiwala, Boxer and Chingum dancing.

videos.title: Motu Patlu: Mission Moon
videos.overview: Motu Patlu struggle to stop a malevolent entity who has been converting the soil of the Moon to gold to incur profits.

videos.title: Motu Patlu: Deep Sea Adventure
videos.overview: Motu Patlu are on a ship voyage, but after the sinking of their ship, they experience a marine journey, the adventure of a lifetime.

videos.title: Motu Patlu: Kung-Fu Kings
videos.overview: An evil Marshal Arts fighter named Tiger Chang comes to Furfuri Nagar and insults them. Motu seeks to train from Him Naresh to teach Tiger a lesson

videos.title: Motu Patlu: Khazaane Ki Race
videos.overview: Motu Patlu clash against John and Chamku Don to uncover a treasure hidden on Christmas Mountain

videos.title: Motu Patlu: Kung Fu Kings Returns
videos.overview: When Tim Tim, Him Naresh's grandson gets abducted by a mysterious monster, Motu Patlu form an unlikely alliance with Tiger Chang to find him. They find out about a comepetition invites strange monsters held by Dr. Snake who is also the father of Tim Tim who turned into a snake due to his inventions and has kidnapped Tim Tim

videos.title: Motu Patlu: Carnival Island!
videos.overview: Motu Patlu have to solve the mystery of the nemesis of Grandpa of Carnival Island, who is bent on destroying all of his creation.

videos.title: Motu Patlu: 36 Ghante Race
videos.overview: Motu Patlu race against time for thirty six hours to solve the case of the theft of the Golden Car award.

videos.title: Motu Patlu: In Alien World!
videos.overview: Motu is being haunted by his father's memories in his dreams. He starts recollecting how his father, a professional astronomer on a mission to unite extraterrestrial civilizations with Earth, invented a telepathic device allowing him to control and alter the minds of any being by simply staring into its eyes, and was abducted by enigmatical personages.

videos.title: Motu Patlu in Double Trouble
videos.overview: After Chingum's wedding, Motu Patlu and friends find themselves mixed up with two scientists who look alike themeselves and two villains struggling for goals of each other.

videos.title: Motu Patlu: The Invisible Plane
videos.overview: When there is a plane competition going on at Furfuri Nagar Airport, Angara and his men steal the Invisible Plane, the country's dream. Motu, Patlu, Dr.Jhatka, Chingum and Ghasitaram get a journey to a secret aircraft facility in the Arctic to find it. They also help the Yetis to save them from evil Angara.

videos.title: Chamatkari Mukut
videos.overview: Motu finds a Crown in a junkyard and buys it. What he is not aware of is that anyone wearing it thinks of himself as a King, Motu immediately starts behaving like a king and treating everyone as slaves.

videos.title: Boxer's Baby
videos.overview: Boxer asks Motu Patlu to babysit his kid. Dr Jhatka gives them a trolley for the kid but the remote lands in the kid's hand and he moves out with the trolley for an adventure ride, worrying Motu Patlu, making them chase him.

videos.title: Super Duper Man
videos.overview: Motu & Patlu want to be Superheroes and protect the people of Furfurinagar. They create Superhero outfits and Dr Jhatka gives them special Superhero gadgets, but every time Motu &Patlu use the gadgets they do not work as intended, creating trouble for Motu.

videos.title: The Race to Rock Garden
videos.overview: Motu Patlu Ghasita & Dr Jhatka incidentally meet a thief who just had an accident, the thief informs them about a 10Cr bag in Rock Garden and faints. Inspector Chingum reaches the spot and inquires what the thief told them about the 10Cr.

videos.title: Flying Helmet
videos.overview: Motu Patlu and John get into a fight in order to get Dr Jhatka's new invention, a flying helmet.

videos.title: Road Roller
videos.overview: Motu scolds the Furfurinagar Municipal Corporation Officer for the bad conditions of a road. The officer offers them to repair the road by evening and get paid a lump sum amount.

videos.title: Ice Factory
videos.overview: Due to unbearable heat, Motu Patlu Jhatka & Ghasita decide to work in the local Ice Factory. What follows, are funny events that take place inside and outside the factory because the four of them get lazy and doze off.

videos.title: Photography Competition
videos.overview: Motu Patlu struggle to get a decent picture of birds which they wish to use in order to enter a photography competition and win a prize.

videos.title: Motu Patlu MBBS
videos.overview: Motu Patlu visit Dr Jhatka's clinic. When he's out both of them pose like doctor's and find unique ways to treat patients that only makes them run away.

videos.title: Mehnat ki Kamayi
videos.overview: Motu Patlu open a paint shop on Ghasitaram's advice and on the first day itself get orders for painting a zebra crossing on a road and painting a house. They make major goof ups and are made to pay up later.

videos.title: Lottery
videos.overview: Patlu reads in the newspaper that thier lottery number has won Crores. Dr Jhatka, Ghasitaram and Jon the Don everybody wants a share of the money, and thus begins the chase as to who would own the ticket and win all the money.

videos.title: Motu the Alien
videos.overview: An Alien lands in furfurinagar and disguises as Motu. He eats everything he sees and creates a menace. It becomes difficult for Motu's friends to know which of the two their friend is.

videos.title: Future Camera
videos.overview: Motu Patlu find an old camera while gardening in a plastic bag, soon they realise that the camera clicks photographs of what is going to happen in the future.

videos.title: Cross Connection
videos.overview: Motu and Patlu open up a PCO service. One day, they receive a call from a stranger asking for a red bag. In spite of repeatedly telling him that he has called on a wrong number, he continues calling. What will they do?

videos.title: Robot Dog
videos.overview: Motu Patlu open up a detective agency. Dr Jhatka gifts them a detective kit that comprises of a magnifying glass, a gun and a robot dog named RoDo. Their first case is given to them by Mrs Sharma whose jewellery has been mugged by John the Don.

videos.title: Motu banega Don
videos.overview: Motu Patlu go to the chaiwala to have some samosas where John's order is given the first preference due to his position as Don. This enrages Motu and he decides to become a don.

videos.title: Super Murgiyan
videos.overview: Motu Patlu plan on starting off a poultry business and buy a few hens. Dr Jhatka gives them a medicine to feed the hens which would enable them to produce more eggs and quicker. This medicine affects the hens adversely giving them super powers.

videos.title: Amir chand Fakir chand
videos.overview: Ghasitaram helps Motu Patlu disguise themselves to escape the angry town folks since Motu Patlu haven't paid their long due bills. They dress up as amirchand and fakirchand who happen to be two wanted goons that Chingam is after. This leads to a chaos.

videos.title: Yamraj
videos.overview: One day a laptop drops down on Motu Patlu from the sky. It is Chitragupta's laptop which contains Patlu's date of death. Chitragupta and Yamraj come down to collect Patlu and Motu Patlu are trying to save Patlu's life by trying to destroy the laptop.

videos.title: FWWE Fight
videos.overview: Motu is on a quest to win Furfurinagar world wrestling entertainment. After he tries to escape the wrestling challenge on the first day, Dr Jhatka gives him some medicine that would make him stronger and help him win.

videos.title: Jinn
videos.overview: Motu Patlu find a lamp one day, while dusting Motu's place. A jinn resides in that lamp. Instead of granting Motu Patlu limited wishes, he is eager to complete every task that they grant him.

videos.title: Murti Ki Khoj
videos.overview: One of the town people accidently comes across a very expensive idol while digging a patch of land. It was being stolen by John when Motu Patlu help recover it. This gives them an idea to find more such idols. What follows is a series of hilarious events.

videos.title: Tigerrr
videos.overview: Furfurinagar is in midst of a huge chaos when a tiger escapes from a nearby zoo. When the town people come stumbling to Chingam for help, Chingam hands over the responsibility of capturing this tiger over to Motu and Patlu?

videos.title: Ek thee Heroine
videos.overview: Posters have been put up across furfurinagar stating the need for a hero. Dr Jhatka and Ghasitaram try to divert Motu Patlu's attention when they come across the poster. This fuels a tiff between the four, as to who would star opposite the beautiful heroine.

videos.title: Magician
videos.overview: Motu & Patlu turn magicians and try to entertain their friends in Furfurinagar.

videos.title: Peacock Fish
videos.overview: Dr Jhatka owns a rare type of fish known as Peacock Fish. He leaves the fish in Motu Patlu's care for a day. Motu is hungry and tries to eat the fish but the fish smartly escapes. Will they be able to get the fish back before Dr Jhatka returns?

videos.title: Mela
videos.overview: Dr Jhatka gives Motu a locket that has the power to control anybody by hypnotising the person. When John learns about this, he sets out to steal the locket. The chase takes place in a faire involving a series of fun places and events.

videos.title: Bhoot Bangla
videos.overview: Posters have been put up all across furfurinagar by Lala Bhagat Ram. He challenges people to spend a night in his haunted villa. Whoever does so successfully, would receive an award of one lakh rupees.

videos.title: Trekking
videos.overview: Motu, Patlu are on a trek along with their friends. They manage to reach a mountain. As Patlu and his friends reach the mountain top, Patlu falls off the mountain. Soon, Motu and Patlu fall prey to an eagle. Will they manage to save themselves?

videos.title: Salim Robot
videos.overview: When Motu and Patlu's play fails to impress the audience, Dr. Jhatka introduces the robot he invented as a character in the play.

videos.title: Black Bull
videos.overview: It's a festive day in furfurinagar, a black bull goes wild and Chingam and Motu claim to control it. The bull hears this and begins chasing them. They try capturing the bull through various ways but all in vain.

videos.title: Kite competition
videos.overview: It's Makar Sankranti and Motu Patlu wish to fly kites. They decide to steal fallen kites, tie a rope to them and fly those instead of buying new ones. Meanwhile, John is trying to smuggle diamonds across the town boundaries to his brother Shaun.

videos.title: Hawaldar
videos.overview: Motu patlu are appointed as hawaldars by Commissioner Bubblegum. On their first day at work, a thief tricks them and escapes. He disguises as Chingam and tells Motu Patlu that the thief is roaming around furfurinagar disguised as Commissioner Bubblegum.

videos.title: Body Guard
videos.overview: Mr Thakral appoints Motu Patlu as his notorious daughter's bodyguard after they save her from John. But John manages to kidnap the little girl again. Will Motu Patlu be able to save her?

videos.title: Giant Mosquitoes
videos.overview: With too many mosquitoes in town, the people of Furfuri Nagar are suffering from malaria. Dr Jhatka prepares a formula to kill the mosquitoes, but Motu's samosa spoils the formula. As Motu sprays the formula, the mosquitoes grow bigger. Will Motu and Patlu find a way to save their friends from the giant mosquitoes?

videos.title: Big John
videos.overview: John the don is constantly teased about his short height. He sets out to find a cure for it. When he finds it, John gulps down the entire bottle of medicine. He grows huge as a giant and takes revenge from everyone who has ever made fun of him.

videos.title: Chamatkari Chashma
videos.overview: Patlu's spectacle frames break. Dr Jhatka offers him to pick up any of the frames from his grandfather's collection. Patlu accidently picks up a pair which evokes a person's bad side. It is now up to Dr Jhatka to get those frames off Patlu's eyes.

videos.title: Mithayi ki dukan
videos.overview: Motu Patlu open up a sweets shop. Motu cannot help himself from eating the samosas made at the shop. So Patlu orders him to stay away from the shop and sends him to deliver a 1000 samosas to a party.

videos.title: Samudri Khajana
videos.overview: Motu, Patlu, Ghasitaram and Jhatka find a treasure map in one of the books at Dr.Jhatka’s lab. Dr. Jhatka gives Motu Patlu a medicine that would help them breathe, swim and talk underwater like a fish. John the Don and goons follow them into the sea. They also fight octopuses and sharks on their way.

videos.title: Cricket league
videos.overview: Motu Patlu start up a cricket league under the name of “Motu Patlu Cricket League” to get famous and mint money. When they try to play in furfurinagar, they land up breaking a couple of house windows and upsetting the town people. Boxer furiously kicks them and they land in a jungle wherein they stumble upon a pirate cave full of treasure. Now they must beat the pirates at a game of cricket in order to get out alive.

videos.title: Snow Park
videos.overview: Dr Jhatka's invention turns Furfuri Nagar into a snow park. With the constant snowfall, everyone starts freezing. Will Motu Patlu be able to bring things to normal condition? Tune in to find out.

videos.title: Ants Land
videos.overview: Motu Patlu are needed in ants' land to help the ants escape Zinguraa (a big black bug that eats ants). The queen asks Dr Antz to have some magical potion and bite Motu Patlu to reduce them to ant size. Dr Antz threatens Motu Patlu to help ants world if they wish to go back to their human size. Not only do Motu Patlu fight Zinguraa but also a big spider. Watch how!

videos.title: Circus
videos.overview: Motu Patlu help the Queen of Englishtaan revive back her diamond necklace from John the don. After they get hold on to the necklace, they go hide in a circus to escape John and his goons. They disguise themselves as a clown and a gorilla but the goons spot them. Watch what happens when Patlu gets stuck inside a lion cage and is tied up on a circus wheel!

videos.title: Gulabi Hathi
videos.overview: Motu Patlu are trying to rescue a baby elephant (Appu) from a circus ringmaster when they goof up and accidentally hurt the ringmaster. This angers the elephant and he begins to chase them. Amidst the chase, the elephant falls in a tub, what happens next is very dangerous! Watch this episode now!

videos.title: Film Producer
videos.overview: Dr.Jhatka advises Motu Patlu to produce a film on wildlife. When they go to the jungle, they come across a talking monkey who agrees to star in their film but throws too many tantrums. As expected, they fall in trouble and are running for their lives, trying to escape anacondas and crocodiles. Watch how they save themselves.

videos.title: Soul Change
videos.overview: Dr.Jhatka has invented a soul changing machine and need two people to experiment on. Ghasitaram tricks Motu Patlu into the machine and their souls interchange. Later that day, at the chaiwala’s stall, Motu Patlu are creating a chaos. Watch how this chaos leads to more chaos and no solution is found out!

videos.title: Gold Samosa
videos.overview: A new samosa stall opens up opposite chaiwala’s stall. He puts up an introductory offer stating that one of the samosas within boxes sold that day would be made out of gold. Whoever gets that samosa is entitled to a year’s supply of free samosas. When John steals the samosa trucks delivering to the new stall, Motu Patlu decide to help Inspector Chingum get the truck back. Meanwhile, the chaiwala is planning something! Watch how!

videos.title: Army
videos.overview: Motu and Patlu get recruited by General Singh in the army. On the border front, General Singh asks Motu Patlu to keep an eye on the enemy camp straight ahead which Motu is successful at. They are later sent to re-capture another post from the enemy followed by a series of hilarious tank and helicopter events. Watch this episode now!!...

videos.title: Wishing Stone
videos.overview: While trying out Jhatka’s new invented cycle, Motu Patlu roll out into the jungle after losing control of it. They find a multicoloured wishing stone that grants all their wishes. Chaos is created around Furfurinagar as one by one every person gets to know about it. John, Jhatka, Ghasitaram, Motu Patlu, each one is trying to get their hands on the wish-granting stone.

videos.title: Mermaid
videos.overview: Motu and Patlu sight a mermaid one day while fishing. Motu Patlu Ghasitaram and Jhatka go scuba diving underwater and find the mermaid being harassed by a big black lobster. They rescue her and she asks them to help her rescue her father from the leader of the black lobsters, Zingga.

videos.title: Dance Competition
videos.overview: Motu Patlu are practising for Jodi Number One dance competition which promises the winners a sum of one lakh. When the competition starts, every pair is trying to bring down the other through various fight tactics.

videos.title: Hero Se Zero
videos.overview: Motu Patlu are at the Chaiwala’s stall when a hijacked school bus full of children pass by. They inform inspector Inspector Chingum about it and help him save the kids and they receive Furfurinagar bahaduri puraskar.

videos.title: Rock Band
videos.overview: Motu Patlu ghasitaram and Jhatka start a rock band. When practising in Furfurinagar, they get beaten up by Boxer and they head off to the jungle. When practising in the jungle, they are thrown fruits at by animals. Similarly, they fail to practice in a cave, at the riverside and in Jhatka’s lab. On the day of the show, all the town people beg John and Inspector Chingum to make the music stop. Watch how terrible they are!

videos.title: Wajan
videos.overview: At Dr.Jhatka’s free clinical checkup, Motu Patlu find out that they are overweight and underweight respectively. They set out on a mission to increase Patlu’s weight and reduce Motu’s. Whatever they do fails! Dr.Jhatka gives them special pills and the pills have an adverse effect on them. Watch what happens to them!

videos.title: The Game
videos.overview: Dr.Jhatka has created a new master game and Motu accidentally presses all of the wrong buttons! They get captured into the game and need to play it to come out!

videos.title: Lost Island
videos.overview: Dr.Jhatka receives free cruise tickets to Bangkok and takes everyone on a cruise. They jump onto a lifeboat after they hear a man yell about the boat sinking. Little did they know that it as a play practice! Motu Patlu are now supposed to try and defeat the gorilla.

videos.title: Jhatka Ki Shaadi
videos.overview: It’s Dr.Jhatka’s day of marriage and the horse runs away because of Motu and they are trying to get him back. Ghasitaram takes Dr.Jhatka and the pandit in a rickshaw!!

videos.title: Chamatkari Joota
videos.overview: Motu is at the mandir complaining about the sorrows of his life in front of god. God grants him magical shoes which now Motu is unable to control or take the shoes off, people of Furfurinagar are tired of being kicked by Motu and everyone is trying to get his shoes off.

videos.title: Motu Ka Birthday
videos.overview: It’s Motu’s birthday and all his friends have decided to put up a show of forgetting his birthday. They plan a surprise party for him which Motu is unaware of. He keeps accidentally ruining the party time and again angering everyone.

videos.title: Holi
videos.overview: Motu is scared of colored water and is trying to escape all the Holi celebration. All of the town people are trying to get him to play and harassing him. Watch how Dr.Jhatka, ghasitaram, Inspector Chingum and Patlu succeed in trapping Motu.

videos.title: Motu Ke Clones
videos.overview: Dr.Jhatka invents a clone building machine. He helps clone Motu in order to help them renovate their house. The clones turn out to be notorious and make Motu Patlu work, throw them out of the house.

videos.title: Mummy
videos.overview: Motu Patlu have go fishing when they find an ancient box. Once taken to Dr Jhatka’s, they find an Egyptian mummy inside with her mummy dog. Motu is in awe of a bracelet on the mummy’s hand and takes it in spite of Patlu’s disagreement. The mummy and dog have now come to life and want the bracelet back.Watch this episode now!!

videos.title: Madari
videos.overview: Motu Patlu decides to become a Madari to earn quick money. Dr.Jhatka makes a realistic monkey suit for Motu and they hit success. Later that day, the zoo officials think that Motu is a monkey too and catch him.

videos.title: Memory Loss
videos.overview: In an accident; Motu falls hard on his head and loses his memory. Dr.Jhatka is trying to get his memory back by making him relive his old memories. His memory comes back but he continues to pretend innocent. Jhatka Patlu and ghasitaram decide to teach him a lesson.

videos.title: Duplicate Patlu
videos.overview: Ghasitaram and Motu Patlu accompany Dr.Jhatka to a hill station for a vacation where one of Dr.Jhatka’s patients resides. Little do they know that a man named Taklu lives there who looks exactly like Patlu. Chaos is created as the people of the hill station mistake Patlu as Taklu and the Furfurinagarites mistake Taklu as Patlu

videos.title: Tel Malish
videos.overview: Motu Patlu get a tel malish while resting on the beach. They both agree and wake up the next morning with 2 ft long grass growing on their heads. They try pulling it off but it grows right back on. Dr.Jhatka tries various ways to get rid of the grass. Watch what happens when nothing works.

videos.title: Ward Boys
videos.overview: Motu Patlu are appointed as ward boys in a new hospital at Furfurinagar. They injure Inspector Inspector Chingum on the first day. What follows is a series of hilarious events taking place while taking care of a bedridden inspector Inspector Chingum.

videos.title: Hero No 1
videos.overview: Motu loses the tickets to Surya Kumar’s film which he gets with a great deal of effort and begins to cry. Someone informs him that Surya Kumar is arriving at Furfurinagar for a shoot. Watch all the jugad that Motu does to get a glimpse of the Hero.

videos.title: Car Mechanic
videos.overview: Motu Patlu start a garage business and find a man hidden in the dickey of a car they are servicing. He is being chased by the black coat gang and Inspector Inspector Chingum.  Watch how he tricks Motu Patlu!

videos.title: Reporter
videos.overview: Motu Patlu area given a job as reporters and are asked to cover an event at a school. Motu gets fired on the first day! Watch how Patlu tries to get back his Job!

videos.title: Bunty Bublu
videos.overview: Bunty and Bablu, notorious food-stealing parrots, find themselves kidnapped by John after entering Motu and Patlu's home. Can Motu and Patlu save the day?

videos.title: Lambi Lambi Naak
videos.overview: Motu and Patlu catch a cold and visit Dr. Jhatka. His medicine makes their noses grow! Can they shrink them back to normal?

videos.title: Bura Na Mano Masti Hai
videos.overview: Motu and Patlu's new entertainment company brings Furfuri Nagar's talent to the stage. Their hilarious show "Bura Na Mano Masti Hai" is ready to launch. Will it be a hit?

videos.title: Motu Patlu Ka Makan
videos.overview: Homeless after demolition, Motu & Patlu get a pricey "human house" from Dr. Jhatka. Can they afford the 10 lakh maintenance?

videos.title: Bijli Gul
videos.overview: John sabotaged Furfuri Nagar's power. Motu & Patlu race to catch him.

videos.title: Dahi Handi
videos.overview: John steals the Dahi Handi prize money! Motu & Patlu must catch him to build a school for Furfuri Nagar.

videos.title: Golden Butterfly
videos.overview: John traps Motu & Patlu in a gold cave. Will they escape his greed and save the treasure?

videos.title: Hawayee Dhaba
videos.overview: Sky-high dhaba heist! Motu & Patlu fight to regain their business from John.

videos.title: Animal Park
